help.catalog:
Usage: automations catalog [OPTIONS]

  List registered background workflow types, optionally by owner project.

Options:
  --project <str>
  --json
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.list:
Usage: automations list [OPTIONS]

  List automation profiles and effective state with pagination.

Options:
  --project <str>
  --limit <int range>   [default: 100; 1<=x<=500]
  --offset <int range>  [default: 0; x>=0]
  --json
  --help                Show this message and exit.
help.show:
Usage: automations show [OPTIONS] {profile_id}

  Show one automation profile, revision, gates, and schedule.

Arguments:
  profile_id  [required]

Options:
  --json
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.validate:
Usage: automations validate [OPTIONS]

read one profile and its revision before editing
validate an automation profile against its registered workflow contract without saving
create or revise a registered automation profile with revision protection
register an owner's existing schedule and cursor without transferring its clock

usage.when: transfer one imported schedule after its owner has durably fenced the old clock
enable future background runs after inspecting a profile revision
stop future background runs without deleting accepted work
inspect shared project automation limits and policy revision
revise project-wide automation limits with an expected revision
inspect the project execution permission gate and hours before changing automated work
change the project execution permission gate or hours through its existing authorized API
start an explicit audited cycle under registered manual-run rules

usage.when: inspect background run results and owner receipts
record review of an imported or changed automation profile
